prequalification_repair.description: Exact tuple equality for analytically exact cycle values was replaced by 11-decimal assertAlmostEqual because binary floating-point representation produced values such as 59.999999999999986. Scientific expectations were unchanged.

evidence: DUMMY-05 FULL/CURTAILED/ZERO oracle solutions are fixed points of the active-set map
interior CURTAILED guesses map in one evaluation to the exact curtailed exchange
subcritical non-switching FULL regime retains error factor -lambda
preregistered lambda=1.5 case forms the predicted FULL/CURTAILED cycle
cycle iterates keep managed delivery within [0,R]
dt reduction to lambda=0.3 restores convergence to the exact oracle
cycle states satisfy provisional balance and local management clipping while not being coupled fixed points
interpretation: Correct local hydrology-before-management clipping and exact provisional mass balance do not guarantee convergence of an undamped coupled iteration. The failure is algorithmic and can include active-set switching.
non_claims: no claim about Ribasim's actual allocation iteration
no claim about iMOD Coupler's actual numerical algorithm
no production solver or coupling change
downstream: Compare analytically bounded under-relaxation and a direct active-set solve against the exact DUMMY-05 oracle.
